questions.question: Grill R2a — the Pause job button (shipped in CARDFIX-1 on the prose card): keep it as an action on the canonical permission card, or drop it entirely (a job blocked on a need is already paused; Deny just leaves it paused)?
options: Keep Pause job on the card

questions.question: Grill R2b — who gets the card? Today prose notifications go to ALL configured notification routes, while permission prompts go only to the approver route. Under one-card, who sees it?

Grill R2c — ratify two corrections Codex proved against the code: (1) PIPED commands never get an Allow button at all (reformulation-only — 0134/0144 already mandate this; my draft wrongly offered Allow-once); retry-and-ask remains the compound-row action for paused jobs. (2) 'Risk-gated family' needs a real mechanism: rails evaluate the exact command BEFORE a family match is honored; a rail hit asks, and that Allow is once-only.
